entries.candidate: DC BLOX Birmingham data center campus (433 6th Street South, Birmingham, Jefferson County, Alabama)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. DC BLOX's Birmingham page (version modified 20 October 2026, bounded below by the Internet Archive copy of 16 September 2026, itself the version of 16 September; captures dcblox-birmingham-20261023.html and ia-dcblox-birmingham-20260916.html) describes a Tier III-certified 31,000 sq ft colocation facility in service, 24x7x365 manned security and a campus being expanded (4 data centres operational and in development, 49 critical MW committed and planned), which would support an operating observation of the first building. No official locator is accessible: Jefferson County's parcel services (jccgis.jccal.org) return HTTP 403 and the City of Bessemer copy of the county parcels does not cover downtown Birmingham. The page's structured data give an operator coordinate (33.499805, -86.821064) that was not independently checked. The Nebius Birmingham record (imported:semiconductor-atlas:nebius-birmingham-alabama) is 2.25 km away, at a Birmingham city-centroid point; no other Atlas record lies within 2 km.
entries.reopen_condition: An accessible official parcel or address point for 433 6th Street South (or a reviewed decision to admit the operator-published facility coordinate as a first-party reference point); the 20 October version stays inside the 85-day window until 2027-01-13.

entries.candidate: DC BLOX Nashville data center project, Grassmere Business Park (Grassmere Commons), Nashville, Davidson County, Tennessee
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. DC BLOX's Nashville project page (datePublished 24 June 2026; versions of 20 August 2026, archived on 14 September, and 20 October 2026) says DC BLOX is planning a single-storey 69,200 sq ft, 10 MW data centre in Grassmere Business Park, an IWD-zoned office park whose current site contains two office buildings, one partly a data centre, next to the Nashville Zoo, and that the project is 'currently in the evaluation phase'. This would support announced status, but the page gives no street address or parcel, and Metro Nashville's parcel layer has at least nine Grassmere Park parcels (601-695 Grassmere Park) with office or business-centre uses, so the site cannot be pinned to one parcel.
entries.reopen_condition: A Metro Nashville record (permit, site plan, council or planning item) or DC BLOX statement naming the address or parcel; then use the Metro Cadastral/Parcels layer for the locator. The 20 October version stays in window until 2027-01-13.

entries.candidate: DC BLOX Atlanta West hyperscale campus (1701 North River Road, Lithia Springs, Douglas County, Georgia)
entries.reason: Not in the Atlas. DC BLOX's page (version modified 13 October 2026) lists 3 data centres 'operational and in development', 1,370,000 sq ft and 200 critical MW committed and planned, with one remaining 80 MW building available; it does not say which buildings are complete or in service and gives no dated construction stage. Douglas County's CivicPlus host has an AI-agent robots group and is not used for parcels. The Atlas record curated:flexential-douglasville-north-river-campus (Flexential Douglasville 2) is 0.52 km from the operator's coordinate (33.733986, -84.615226); it is a different operator's campus.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated DC BLOX or county record stating which Atlanta West buildings operate or are under construction, plus an official parcel locator; screen again against the Flexential Douglasville record.
